key_concepts: Chemical reactions can occur at different rates, such as slow rusting and rapid burning.
Temperature affects reaction rate by changing the kinetic energy of particles.
Higher reactant concentration increases reaction rate by causing more collisions.
Greater surface area increases reaction rate by increasing collision frequency.
Catalysts speed up chemical reactions without being permanently changed.
Inhibitors slow down or prevent chemical reactions.
Decomposition reactions break complex molecules into simpler substances.
Combination reactions form more complex substances from simpler ones.
Single replacement reactions involve an element replacing another in a compound.
Double replacement reactions involve exchange of ions between two compounds.
